name: Vaisala Xweather
description: Provides access to real-time, forecast, and historical weather intelligence for analysis and planning. Designed to support operational decisions outputs based on observed and forecast conditions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Vaisala Xweather to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Vaisala Xweather to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.api.xweather.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Vaisala Xweather MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vaisala Xweather lists 19 MCP tools, including xweather_get_aggregated_daily_weather_summaries, xweather_get_aggregated_weather_conditions, xweather_get_current_active_tropical_systems, xweather_get_current_active_weather_alerts, xweather_get_current_airquality, xweather_get_current_tropical_storms_near_location, xweather_get_current_weather, xweather_get_current_weather_impacts, xweather_get_daily_weather_summaries, xweather_get_forecast_airquality, xweather_get_forecast_precipitation_timing, and xweather_get_forecast_weather.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Vaisala Xweather?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Vaisala Xweather in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Vaisala Xweather MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vaisala Xweather requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Vaisala Xweather is developed by Vaisala Xweather. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
